name.ja: 30MM ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON ARQUEBUS ADD VE-40A オープンフェイス
name.en: 30MM ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON ARQUEBUS ADD VE-40A Open Face

description.ja: 『ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON』のアイテムが『30 MINUTES MISSIONS』シリーズで商品化。
description.en: "ARMORED CORE VI FIRES OF RUBICON " items are commercialized in the " 30 MINUTES MISSIONS" series.

description.ja: シリーズのキーコンセプト「シンプル組み立て」「カスタム遊び」のもと、V.IIスネイルが操る「オープンフェイス」が登場。
description.en: Based on the series' key concepts of "simple assembly " and " custom play," the " Open Face" operated by V.II Snail is now available.

description.ja: • 頭部、コア、腕部、脚部それぞれにシリーズ共通構造を採用し、ゲーム内同様に「アセンブル」をプラモデルで楽しめる。
description.en: • The head, core, arms, and legs each use the same structure as the series, allowing you to enjoy "assembling" the plastic model just like in the game.

description.ja: • 両肩武器と一部左手武器の取り付けには3mmジョイントを採用し様々なアセンブルに対応可能。
description.en: • 3mm joints are used to attach both shoulder weapons and some left-handed weapons, allowing for a variety of assemblies.
• Weapons include "VP-66EG ", " VE-67LLA ", " VE-60SNA ", and " Vvc-70VPM".

description.ja: • 「VE-67LLA」は格納状態と展開状態の2種類に加えエフェクトパーツが付属。
description.en: • "VE-67LLA" comes in two types: retracted state and expanded state, as well as effect parts.

description.ja: • 別売りの「アクションベース7」等に接続可能なアーマーパーツが付属。
description.en: • Comes with armor parts that can be connected to "Action Base 7" etc. sold separately.

accessories.ja: アクションベース接続用パーツ×1
